protocol.operating_point_validation: exploratory sweep; independent frozen-setting confirmation not implied
protocol.retrieval: lexical only, OR over the lowercase alphanumeric query word set, top 100; each system's own analyzer and default BM25
protocol.timing: one query at a time, single client thread; WARM timed inside its process, Python systems inside their worker
protocol.warm_rows: warm = `--encode lexical` (BM25 index only, like-for-like); warm-eager = default eager encoding (chunk hypervectors at ingest); every build repeat is one cold process
protocol.interleaving: each round runs WARM and every comparator once, order rotated per round
protocol.peak_rss: wait4 rusage of that phase's own process, forked from a small helper so it never inherits the orchestrator's RSS (Linux)
protocol.disk: allocated bytes of the store directory (du); where the filesystem reports sparse files as fully allocated, only non-zero 4 KiB blocks count
protocol.passes: per timed pass: queries, total_ns and p50/p90/p99/max ns of the per-query latencies

timing_boundary.warm: native Rust API call in the engine process (no language binding); text: BM25 index only (`--encode lexical`); ANN: public-bench loop
timing_boundary.warm-eager: native Rust API call in the engine process (no language binding); text: BM25 index plus chunk hypervectors at ingest (`--encode eager`)
timing_boundary.lancedb: CPython + Arrow call per query (multi-threaded Rust runtime inside)
timing_boundary.chroma: CPython client call per query (Rust core inside)
timing_boundary.qdrant-local: CPython client call per query (embedded local mode)
timing_boundary.milvus-lite: CPython client call per query (embedded server process)
timing_boundary.sqlite-fts5: CPython sqlite3 call per query (query string built outside the timer)
timing_boundary.tantivy: CPython tantivy-py call per query (stored id fetched per hit)
timing_boundary.lucene: in-process JVM API call, after a full untimed JIT warm-up pass
timing_boundary.scann: CPython (pybind11) call per query; the ScaNN searcher runs its own thread pool for training only
timing_boundary.pynndescent: CPython + numba-compiled kernel per query (JIT compile inside cold start)
timing_boundary.diskann: CPython 3.11 binding call per query (diskannpy StaticMemoryIndex)
timing_boundary.warm-server: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; ANN: POST /api/v1/query with index=graph and per-request ef; text: POST /api/v1/memory/recall, lexical weight only
timing_boundary.qdrant-server: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; POST /collections/c/points/query (REST, not gRPC); max_search_threads=1
timing_boundary.weaviate: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; GraphQL nearVector (REST, not gRPC); ef set on the class between sweep points
timing_boundary.opensearch-knn: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; _search knn query with method_parameters.ef_search; concurrent segment search off, one shard
timing_boundary.pgvector: psycopg 3 over one TCP connection, server-side prepared statement; max_parallel_workers_per_gather=0; enable_seqscan=off
timing_boundary.redis-vss: redis-py over one TCP connection, FT.SEARCH KNN with NOCONTENT; query engine WORKERS 0 (main thread)
timing_boundary.meilisearch: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; POST /indexes/docs/search (its own ranking rules, not BM25; at most 10 query words are used)
timing_boundary.typesense: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; GET search with drop_tokens_threshold=100 (its own text-match ranking, not BM25)
timing_boundary.opensearch-bm25: one persistent HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connection from a CPython client on loopback; request body serialized before the timer, response JSON decoded inside it; _search match query (OR), english analyzer, default BM25; one shard
timing_boundary.pg-tsvector: psycopg 3 over one TCP connection, server-side prepared statement; OR of the query words via to_tsquery, ranked by ts_rank (not BM25)
timing_boundary.paradedb: psycopg 3 over one TCP connection, server-side prepared statement; `|||` (match any word) over an english-stemmed field, BM25 via pdb.score
